name: Can Hometelligent Inc. handle permit coordination for commercial projects in addition to residential?

mainEntity.name: Can Hometelligent Inc. handle permit coordination for commercial projects in addition to residential?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Hometelligent Inc. provides permit coordination services for both residential and commercial construction projects across our service areas. While the fundamental process remains similar, commercial projects often involve additional permits, such as those related to occupancy, accessibility (ADA), and specific business licenses, which can increase the complexity. Our experience in navigating both residential and commercial regulations ensures all necessary requirements are met.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Hometelligent Inc. handles permit coordination for both residential and commercial projects. Commercial projects often require additional specific permits.
